quotations.projectAddress: 255 Musters Road, West Bridgford, Nottingham, NG2 7DD
quotations.projectDescription: Single Storey Flat Roof Rear Extension to the existing Bungalow, providing a new Living Room with Sliding Doors, a Bedroom and an En-Suite, replacing the existing Garden Room Conservatory, delivered under Permitted Development.

lineItems.itemDescription:
1. A free, no obligation telephone design consultation held on 07-Sep-2026.
2. Covered the brief for the rear extension, the condition of the existing garden room conservatory, and the routes available through the planning system.
3. Initial permitted development checks were carried out on the property during the call.

1. Three dimensional model of the existing bungalow, built from the measurement information and photographs supplied by the Client.
2. Forms the base model from which the existing plans, elevations and site drawings are derived.

1. Development of the Client's preliminary layout into a full three dimensional model of the proposed extension.
2. Resolution of the sliding door opening, the Bedroom and En-Suite arrangement, and the number and position of the flat roof lights.
3. Forms the base model from which every proposed drawing is derived.

1. Interactive three dimensional model issued through the Noble Architecture Project Portal, allowing the proposals to be walked through online before anything is committed to.
2. Provided at no charge. The model is an inherent by-product of Noble Architecture's working method rather than a separately priced deliverable.

lineItems.description: Measured Building Survey & Specialist Site Surveys
lineItems.itemDescription:
1. No measured building survey, laser scan survey or site dimensional survey is included. The Client will carry out his own survey and supply the measurement information.
2. Any specialist site survey, including drainage, structural or ground investigation, sits outside Noble Architecture's scope. See the Building Surveying contract.
